bio: There are some places that truly reflect the heart and soul of a neighborhood, and in Bushwick, it's Gordo's Cantina. Family-friendly and with something for everyone, this spot's name also ensures that portion sizes are mighty. Of course, nobody is complaining, thanks to the talents of Chef Reyna Morales, who hails from Mexico City and whose careful handling of familiar favorites goes a long way.Order the tacos tucked with crumbles of aromatic chorizo with a mild heat, while the chile relleno stuffed with creamy queso fresco and beans is a savory delight. This hangout also dishes out a satisfying mole, as seen in enchiladas stuffed with tender shredded chicken....
